items.title: 6.6 Reaction ki enthalpy tabdeeli ki paimaish (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.6, printed page 124.

blocks.text: Physical ya chemical tabdeeli mein kitni heat nikalti ya jazb hoti hai, yeh ek aale (instrument) se napi jati hai jise calorimeter kehte hain; yeh aam taur par process ke dauran temperature ki tabdeeli napta hai. Sab se saada calorimeter mein ek insulated bartan (jis se heat bahar na jaye), ek stirrer (hilane wala) aur ek thermometer hota hai. Calorimeter kai qisam ke hain, lekin yahan sirf “Glass Calorimeter” bayan kiya jayega.
Calorimetry is haqeeqat par qaim hai ke 1 g pani ka temperature 1 °C barhane ke liye 4.18 J energy lagti hai.

blocks.title: Specific heat capacity
blocks.text: Kisi substance ki ek muqarrar miqdar ka temperature 1 K (ya 1 °C) barhane ke liye jitni heat energy chahiye, use us ki specific heat capacity, c, kehte hain. Pani ke 1 g ke liye yeh 4.18 J hai.
Is liye pani ki specific heat capacity 4.18 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹ (ya J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab tareef mein 'mass 1kg' likhti hai magar value 4.18 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹ deti hai, jo 1 g ki hai. 1 kg pani ke liye yeh 4180 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ hoti hai.
Heat ki shakal mein muntaqil (transfer) hone wali energy is formula se nikalti hai:

items: q = muntaqil hone wali heat, joules mein
m = pani/solution ka mass, grams mein
c = pani ki specific heat = 4.184 J/g °C

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Tf aakhri (final) aur Ti shuru (initial) ka temperature hai. 1 °C ki tabdeeli 1 K ki tabdeeli ke barabar hai, is liye ΔT ko °C ya K kisi mein bhi likh sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: 150 g pani 20.0 °C se 24.0 °C tak garam hota hai. Is ne kitni heat jazb ki?
blocks.explanation: q = m × c × ΔT = 150 × 4.18 × 4.0 = 2508 J, yani taqreeban 2.5 kJ.

items: Calorimeter (insulated bartan, stirrer, thermometer) temperature ki tabdeeli se heat napta hai.
q = c × m × ΔT; pani ki c = 4.18 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹.
